QUOTE: "Rebuild if the index is older. If the index is newer, only restarting the client helps." and "The `schema` case where the index is newer than the server has no fix a consumer can take except restarting the client."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when the index is newer than the server, rebuilding doesn't clear the schema axis, so it is unresolvable by rebuild. It doesn't give the "re-stamps the same newer version" reason, but the substance is there.
